Description: "Wrap the page content in #magnifiable-page and update cursor-hidden class application based on isMagnifierActive."
Instruction: "Wrap the header, main, and footer elements inside a magnifiable-page container, and modify cursor-none condition to depend on isMagnifierActive."
ReplacementContent: "  return (\n    <div id={isPink ? \"landing-v3\" : \"landing-v5\"} className={`min-h-screen font-sans antialiased transition-colors duration-300 ${pageBg} ${isHovering && !isInteractive && isMagnifierActive ? \"lg:cursor-none\" : \"\"}`}>\n      <div id=\"magnifiable-page\" className=\"w-full relative\">"
